data.label: include
data.reason_zh: DAGLoop 将实验结果结构化为研究记忆，据此保留或修正设计决策并规划后续实验，构成持续反馈的方法改进闭环。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory.
scope_support.object_quote: This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones
scope_support.persistence_quote: planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved
